title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED Broadway Musical in Springfield, MO – Jan 2027
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical about Maizy and Beau, whose wedding plans collide with the dying corn that protects their small community of Cob County, and the unlikely hero and con artist who get caught up in the town's fight. It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, some adult language and corny innuendo. Performances run Tuesday, January 19 through Thursday, January 21, 2027, at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO; for now, tickets are available only through Broadway Season subscriptions.
